source.how: get_computed_styles for the declared values; get_node_info / get_children for the laid-out rects, whose world coordinates are what `gaps` is computed from.

note: Two figures: the frame (head, legend, plot row stacked inside a 24px inset) and the plot row (the 32px tick column, an 8px gap, and the plot column that takes the rest). Extracting the plot row found the sheet's one defect: the specimen frame was typed 784 wide around a plot drawn at 684, so the plot column hugged its SVG and left 10px of the row unfilled — `track-is-the-sum-of-its-parts` read 734 against parts adding to 724. The code's plot column is `flex-1` and always fills. Fixed in Paper by setting the frame to 774, the width the plot's own arithmetic implies (684 + 8 + 32 + 2 × 24 + 2 × 1); every inner value is unchanged. The legend entry has its own case since `measure` looks for children inside the container: a legend only exists with two series, and a document-wide query put both entries into one union. The plot column (extracted 2026-11-11, the plan's 'geometry for the axis') stacks the 241px plot — 240 plus the half-pixel baseline — over the 16px x-axis tick row, 8px apart, under an 8px top inset that keeps the top tick label clear of the head: 8 + 241 + 8 + 16 = 273, the plot row's height.

lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: The frame's children are an unshaped header, a legend and a plot row — none has a corner for the 8px frame radius to be concentric with.
The plot row is an invisible track with no fill or border, so it has no radius to be concentric with.

lawsNotDeclared.uniform-inset: Deliberately 8px at the top only: room for the top tick label, which is centred on the highest gridline and would otherwise be clipped by the head. The sides belong to the plot row, the bottom to the frame.
lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: An invisible track with no fill or border. The floating tooltip inside it is absolutely positioned and is not part of the track.

lawsNotDeclared.uniform-inset: Deliberately 8 inline, 4 block: two entries' inline paddings together are the legend's 16px gap, and the block padding only grows the line to a 24px target.
lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: The key and the name have no corner of their own for the 4px hover fill to be concentric with.

deviations.what: The sheet's tick column is 256 tall beside a 273 plot column; the render's tick column stretches to the row's full height.
deviations.why: On the sheet the column is typed to the plot's height and the ticks are spaced inside it; in code the ticks are absolutely positioned at y(t), so the column's own height carries nothing and stretching is the default. Neither height is asserted — the union of the two children is the full row on both sides, which is what the laws read.

deviations.what: The sheet's entry is 24 tall around a 16px line; the render's line is 15.6, so a 24px floor holds the height and the block gaps read 4.2.
deviations.why: label-sm's line-height is 1.3 × 12px; Paper rounds a text node to whole pixels. The floor is the tooltip chip's padding-plus-minimum pair: the inset stays declared, and the target is 24 either way.
